Same outline/pins/grant as mc_r3. | Four actual independent phase-aligned pll_hbm_data storage roots: fixed bit slices replace a single >15k storage root; no clock gating, no timing exception between same-phase roots, no normal-cycle delta. Fix: idle_hbm from registered pin captures only (+1 pll_hbm edge on the drain observation, no schedule use) and idle_hbm in the hclk output set.
